name: lintify
purpose: Reuse a native linter where possible and verify discovery, locations, exits and real exceptions.

criteria.description: Run the actual linter on discovered targets, rather than passing because fixtures were ignored.
Verify diagnostic locations, messages and process exit behavior.
Exercise good/bad/transfer/exception fixtures; semantic model rules remain probabilistic.

native_scaffold.description: Create the existing native ESLint/Lintbook/GPTLint example package; installation never activates it.

limits: Mechanical verification checks recorded facts and actual retained bytes; a recorded semantic inspection is not authenticated judgment.
Compilation and fixture success do not prove complete semantic workflow performance or provider/native-host activation.
Run real good/bad/transfer/exception files through the selected native CLI; an ignored fixture or Markdown rule alone cannot prove enforcement.
